rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for leafy plants used to flavour or season food.

example.english: When I add a little herb to the soup, the whole soup smells much better.
example.traditional: 煲湯嗰陣加少少香草，成煲湯即刻香好多。
example.jyutping: bou1 tong1 go2 zan6 gaa1 siu2 siu2 hoeng1 cou2 sing4 bou1 tong1 zik1 hak1 hoeng1 hou2 do1

rows.note: Use this specifically for cannabis as a drug or plant.

example.english: Someone was secretly smoking herb in the back alley.
example.traditional: 有人喺後巷偷偷食大麻。
example.jyutping: jau5 jan4 hai2 hau6 hong2 tau1 tau1 sik6 daai6 maa4
